task: read-only frozen SD boot failure source and historical evidence
verdict: The reported sd_copy -2 during boot-image copy matches the CRC16 mismatch return in both frozen C and directly decoded frozen FPGA ROM instructions. It is not a timeout code. Root cause of mismatched computed/received CRC remains unknown; overlapping FPGA readback is a hypothesis, not established cause.

actual_frozen_source.generic_bootrom_is_not_selected: corev_apu/bootrom/bootrom.sv is filtered out by frozen CVA6 Makefile:784
actual_frozen_source.C_to_SV_scope: Frozen C text exists in the same bit staging tree, but this task did not compile it to prove complete historical C-to-ROM reproduction. The specific return branch is verified independently from the frozen SV ROM data, so diagnosis does not rely only on present C.

ROM_static_decoding.method: Read the exact895 packed64b constants from frozen bootrom_64.sv; reverse array word order and encode each little-endian as specified by gen_rom.py:112-126. Decode to RV64 disassembly without compiling or executing ROM.
ROM_static_decoding.data_token_poll: offset0x6de sd_dummy call / 0x6e2 bne back until0xfe; no counter/deadline
ROM_static_decoding.CRC_path: 8x64B reads to make512B block, CRC accumulator helper0x630; received two CRC bytes at0x71e and0x72c; offset0x738 bne computed-vs-received to0x7ac
ROM_static_decoding.failure_return: offset0x7ac li s0,-2; offset0x7ae jumps to STOP/CMD12; offset0x796 mv a0,s0 and0x7aa ret
ROM_static_decoding.ROM_physical_base: linker.lds:5 records0x10000; listed addresses are offsets relative to extracted ROM

current_attempt.failure_stage: gpt_find_boot_partition after successful LBA1 and partition-entry reads, during CMD18 copy of partition0 from LBA0x800 to0x107ff inclusive
current_attempt.important_limit: Printed GPT fields are not a separate validation of GPT header/table CRC. Successful sd_copy of metadata sectors implies their SD data-block CRC checks passed; payload hash/complete copy is not established.

exact_error_propagation.fact: CMD18 response failure=-1; data CRC mismatch=-2
Combine received two CRC bytes; compare with locally computed CRC; mismatch selects-2, issue STOP and return
Actual log is after copying boot image; prints sd_copy res and then returns wrapper-2
Jump to0x80000000 only on successful GPT/copy; otherwise permanent empty loop

CMD_response_poll.unit: calls/bytes from sd_dummy, not milliseconds or cycles
CMD_response_poll.on_exhaustion: returns the last response byte; no-2 timeout return

SPI_RX_wait.unit: unbounded MMIO FIFO status polling; no wall-clock deadline

SPI_nop_delay.unit: nop-loop iterations; physical elapsed time not measured
SPI_nop_delay.limit: Do not convert loops to fixed seconds from nominal CPU50MHz; loop/MMIO/SPI/DDR progress and actual clock differ

timeout_units.CRC_failure: A returned-2 requires the CRC comparison to have been reached; this transcript is not a timeout/hang transcript.

dot_interpretation.rule: print one dot only after successful block CRC when remaining i%1000==0, before decrement
dot_interpretation.conditions: Bounds assume complete uninterrupted UART capture with exactly10 dots and this ROM code; no exact failing LBA or CRC values are printed. Progress dots are block counts, not elapsed-time markers.

historical_success.elapsed_scope: Includes initial SSH identity, board sync, FPGA programming and repeated SSH polls; commands have no per-command start/end timestamps, so exact programming-start-to-SSH-success interval is not recorded. Do not substitute file mtime for event timing.
historical_success.same_artifact_UART_limit: Only one period byte (hex2e) retained, not a complete successful startup transcript
historical_success.success_log_bit_scope: Older clean bit, not the isolated full artifact; nevertheless generated bootrom_64.sv/.h and all examined SD/GPT/SPI/main sources are byte-identical to this frozen isolated bit tree

confirmed: metadata LBA1 and partition-table block copies passed the SD data CRC check
during partition0 copy, one received512B block or its receivedCRC was inconsistent with CPU-computedCRC over the copied data
failure precedes OpenSBI/Linux execution; changing kernel metadata is not a fix for this observed boot stage
same generated BootROM has an older successful complete SD-copy transcript
unresolved: exact failed block/LBA and both CRC values
whether corrupted bytes were read via SD/SPI, altered in FIFO/AXI/DDR, or miscomputed/read by CPU
whether concurrent masked readback caused or merely overlapped the failure
whether a new no-readback same-bit boot will complete
root_cause_determination.recovery_hypothesis_limit: A same-bit boot without overlapping readback can provide a new bounded contrast. Success alone would not identify the physical causal mechanism; continued dots alone are progress, not failure or complete Linux. A short arbitrary wait is unsupported; require done/OpenSBI/Linux or an actual terminal error.

execution.reads: Targeted frozen source/SV/h/build inclusion; one explicitly located older successful raw UART prefix; same-artifact boot result timestamps
